verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’ĕ·lî·p̄az hat·tê·mā·nî way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Eliphaz the Temanite . . . replied
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO respondeu Elifaz o temanita, e disse:

verses.original: הֲנִסָּ֬ה דָבָ֣ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ תִּלְאֶ֑ה וַעְצֹ֥ר בְּ֝מִלִּ֗ין מִ֣י יוּכָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hă·nis·sāh ḏā·ḇār ’ê·le·ḵā til·’eh wa‘·ṣōr bə·mil·lîn mî yū·ḵāl
verses.literal: If one ventures a word with you will you be wearied Yet who can keep from speaking
verses.literalPt: Se intentarmos falar-te, enfadar-te-ás? Mas quem poderia conter as palavras?

verses.original: הִ֭נֵּה יִסַּ֣רְתָּ רַבִּ֑ים וְיָדַ֖יִם רָפ֣וֹת תְּחַזֵּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yis·sar·tā rab·bîm wə·yā·ḏa·yim rā·p̄ō·wṯ tə·ḥaz·zêq
verses.literal: Surely you have instructed many and have strengthened their feeble hands
verses.literalPt: Eis que ensinaste a muitos, e tens fortalecido as mãos fracas.

verses.original: כּ֭וֹשֵׁל יְקִימ֣וּן מִלֶּ֑יךָ וּבִרְכַּ֖יִם כֹּרְע֣וֹת תְּאַמֵּֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: kō·wō·šêl yə·qî·mūn mil·le·ḵā ū·ḇir·ka·yim kō·rə·‘ō·wṯ tə·’am·mêṣ
verses.literal: Your words have steadied those who stumbled you have braced the knees that were buckling
verses.literalPt: As tuas palavras firmaram os que tropeçavam e os joelhos desfalecentes tens fortalecido.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַתָּ֨ה׀ תָּב֣וֹא אֵלֶ֣יךָ וַתֵּ֑לֶא תִּגַּ֥ע עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ וַתִּבָּהֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘at·tāh tā·ḇō·w ’ê·le·ḵā wat·tê·le tig·ga‘ ‘ā·ḏe·ḵā wat·tib·bā·hêl
verses.literal: But now trouble has come upon you and you are weary It strikes you . . . and you are dismayed
verses.literalPt: Mas agora, que se trata de ti, te enfadas; e tocando-te a ti, te perturbas.

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א יִ֭רְאָתְךָ כִּסְלָתֶ֑ךָ תִּ֝קְוָתְךָ֗ וְתֹ֣ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō yir·’ā·ṯə·ḵā kis·lā·ṯe·ḵā tiq·wā·ṯə·ḵā wə·ṯōm də·rā·ḵe·ḵā
verses.literal: Is your reverence not your confidence and the uprightness of your ways your hope
verses.literalPt: Porventura não é o teu temor de Deus a tua confiança, e a tua esperança a integridade dos teus caminhos?

verses.original: זְכָר־ נָ֗א מִ֤י ה֣וּא נָקִ֣י אָבָ֑ד וְ֝אֵיפֹ֗ה יְשָׁרִ֥ים נִכְחָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵār- nā mî hū nā·qî ’ā·ḇāḏ wə·’ê·p̄ōh yə·šā·rîm niḵ·ḥā·ḏū
verses.literal: Consider now, I plead Who being innocent has ever perished Or where have the upright been destroyed
verses.literalPt: Lembra-te agora qual é o inocente que jamais pereceu? E onde foram os sinceros destruídos?

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתִי חֹ֣רְשֵׁי אָ֑וֶן וְזֹרְעֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל יִקְצְרֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯî ḥō·rə·šê ’ā·wen wə·zō·rə·‘ê ‘ā·māl yiq·ṣə·ru·hū
verses.literal: As I have observed those who plow iniquity and those who sow trouble reap the same
verses.literalPt: Segundo eu tenho visto, os que lavram iniqüidade, e semeiam mal, segam o mesmo.

verses.original: מִנִּשְׁמַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וּמֵר֖וּחַ אַפּ֣וֹ יִכְלֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: min·niš·maṯ ’ĕ·lō·w·ha yō·ḇê·ḏū ū·mê·rū·aḥ ’ap·pōw yiḵ·lū
verses.literal: By the breath of God they perish and by the blast of His anger they are consumed
verses.literalPt: Com o hálito de Deus perecem; e com o sopro da sua ira se consomem.

verses.original: שַׁאֲגַ֣ת אַ֭רְיֵה וְק֣וֹל שָׁ֑חַל וְשִׁנֵּ֖י כְפִירִ֣ים נִתָּֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ša·’ă·ḡaṯ ’ar·yêh wə·qō·wl šā·ḥal wə·šin·nê ḵə·p̄î·rîm nit·tā·‘ū
verses.literal: The lion may roar and the fierce lion may growl yet the teeth of the young lions are broken
verses.literalPt: O rugido do leão, e a voz do leão feroz, e os dentes dos leõezinhos se quebram.

verses.original: לַ֭יִשׁ אֹבֵ֣ד מִבְּלִי־ טָ֑רֶף וּבְנֵ֥י לָ֝בִ֗יא יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: la·yiš ’ō·ḇêḏ mib·bə·lî- ṭā·rep̄ ū·ḇə·nê lā·ḇî yiṯ·pā·rā·ḏū
verses.literal: The old lion perishes for lack of prey and the cubs of the lioness are scattered
verses.literalPt: Perece o leão velho, porque não tem presa; e os filhos da leoa andam dispersos.

verses.original: וְ֭אֵלַי דָּבָ֣ר יְגֻנָּ֑ב וַתִּקַּ֥ח אָ֝זְנִ֗י שֵׁ֣מֶץ מֶֽנְהֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·lay dā·ḇār yə·ḡun·nāḇ wat·tiq·qaḥ ’ā·zə·nî šê·meṣ men·hū
verses.literal: Now a word came to me secretly my ears caught a whisper of it
verses.literalPt: Uma coisa me foi trazida em segredo; e os meus ouvidos perceberam um sussurro dela.

verses.original: בִּ֭שְׂעִפִּים מֵחֶזְיֹנ֣וֹת לָ֑יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֥ל תַּ֝רְדֵּמָ֗ה עַל־ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: biś·‘ip·pîm mê·ḥez·yō·nō·wṯ lā·yə·lāh bin·p̄ōl tar·dê·māh ‘al- ’ă·nā·šîm
verses.literal: In disquieting visions in the night when deep sleep falls on men
verses.literalPt: Entre pensamentos vindos de visões da noite, quando cai sobre os homens o sono profundo,

verses.original: פַּ֣חַד קְ֭רָאַנִי וּרְעָדָ֑ה וְרֹ֖ב עַצְמוֹתַ֣י הִפְחִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: pa·ḥaḏ qə·rā·’a·nî ū·rə·‘ā·ḏāh wə·rōḇ ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯay hip̄·ḥîḏ
verses.literal: fear and trembling came over me and made all my bones shudder
verses.literalPt: Sobrevieram-me o espanto e o tremor, e todos os meus ossos estremeceram.

verses.original: וְ֭רוּחַ עַל־ פָּנַ֣י יַחֲלֹ֑ף תְּ֝סַמֵּ֗ר שַֽׂעֲרַ֥ת בְּשָׂרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rū·aḥ ‘al- pā·nay ya·ḥă·lōp̄ tə·sam·mêr śa·‘ă·raṯ bə·śā·rî
verses.literal: Then a spirit glided past my face and the hair on my body bristled
verses.literalPt: Então um espírito passou por diante de mim; fez-me arrepiar os cabelos da minha carne.

verses.original: יַעֲמֹ֤ד׀ וְֽלֹא־ אַכִּ֬יר מַרְאֵ֗הוּ תְּ֭מוּנָה לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י דְּמָמָ֖ה וָק֣וֹל אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·mōḏ wə·lō- ’ak·kîr mar·’ê·hū tə·mū·nāh lə·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·nāy də·mā·māh wā·qō·wl ’eš·mā‘
verses.literal: It stood still but I could not discern its appearance a form loomed before my eyes and I heard a whispering voice
verses.literalPt: Parou ele, porém não conheci a sua feição; um vulto estava diante dos meus olhos; houve silêncio, e ouvi uma voz que dizia:

verses.original: הַֽ֭אֱנוֹשׁ מֵאֱל֣וֹהַ יִצְדָּ֑ק אִ֥ם מֵ֝עֹשֵׂ֗הוּ יִטְהַר־ גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ĕ·nō·wōš mê·’ĕ·lō·w·ha yiṣ·dāq ’im mê·‘ō·śê·hū yiṭ·har- gā·ḇer
verses.literal: Can a mortal be more righteous than God or a man more pure than his Maker
verses.literalPt: Seria porventura o homem mais justo do que Deus? Seria porventura o homem mais puro do que o seu Criador?

verses.original: הֵ֣ן בַּ֭עֲבָדָיו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וּ֝בְמַלְאָכָ֗יו יָשִׂ֥ים תָּהֳלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hên ba·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw lō ya·’ă·mîn ū·ḇə·mal·’ā·ḵāw yā·śîm tā·ho·lāh
verses.literal: If God puts no trust in His servants and He charges His angels with error
verses.literalPt: Eis que ele não confia nos seus servos e aos seus anjos atribui loucura;

verses.original: אַ֤ף׀ שֹׁכְנֵ֬י בָֽתֵּי־ חֹ֗מֶר אֲשֶׁר־ בֶּעָפָ֥ר יְסוֹדָ֑ם יְ֝דַכְּא֗וּם לִפְנֵי־ עָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ šō·ḵə·nê ḇāt·tê- ḥō·mer ’ă·šer- be·‘ā·p̄ār yə·sō·w·ḏām yə·ḏak·kə·’ūm lip̄·nê- ‘āš
verses.literal: how much more those who dwell in houses of clay whose foundations are in the dust who can be crushed . . . like a moth
verses.literalPt: Quanto menos àqueles que habitam em casas de lodo, cujo fundamento está no pó, e são esmagados como a traça!

verses.original: מִבֹּ֣קֶר לָעֶ֣רֶב יֻכַּ֑תּוּ מִבְּלִ֥י מֵ֝שִׂ֗ים לָנֶ֥צַח יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mib·bō·qer lā·‘e·reḇ yuk·kat·tū mib·bə·lî mê·śîm lā·ne·ṣaḥ yō·ḇê·ḏū
verses.literal: They are smashed to pieces from dawn to dusk unnoticed . . . they perish forever
verses.literalPt: Desde a manhã até à tarde são despedaçados; e eternamente perecem sem que disso se faça caso.

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ נִסַּ֣ע יִתְרָ֣ם בָּ֑ם יָ֝מ֗וּתוּ וְלֹ֣א בְחָכְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- nis·sa‘ yiṯ·rām bām yā·mū·ṯū wə·lō ḇə·ḥā·ḵə·māh
verses.literal: Are not their tent cords pulled up so that they die without wisdom
verses.literalPt: Porventura não passa com eles a sua excelência? Morrem, mas sem sabedoria.
